title: Pleading the Blood for a Mighty Harvest
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a passionate and prophetic prayer for the upcoming crusade in Africa, calling out for the hearts of the people to be open to the gospel and for the Holy Spirit to bring great fruit and results. As Pastor Zehner leads in prayer, he releases a fervent cry for the salvation of souls, the healing of bodies, and the growth of churches, and he encourages believers to join in prayer for this miraculous outreach effort.
